headline: Low prompt-injection and data-leakage risk; no shared I/O surfaces are documented, but marker is runnable while the course repo is not.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel is documented: agent_a has no io_surfaces and agent_b has no read/write filesystem, MCP, or browser surfaces. With no bridge, prompt injection from agent_a into agent_b is not plausible from the profiles alone.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator copies agent_a output into agent_b prompts or files, injection becomes possible.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared clipboard or workspace.
Do not pipe agent_a text directly into agent_b prompts.
Add a provenance tag if any orchestrator relays outputs between agents.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither agent documents filesystem access or network egress, and both profiles show data_classes_touched as empty. Without a shared workspace or outbound channel, there is no documented path for sensitive data to leak between them.
conditions: IF a shared filesystem or manual file handoff is introduced, leakage risk increases.
mitigations: Avoid placing sensitive files in any shared directory.
Disable manual copy-paste of document contents between agents.
Review any orchestrator for hidden logging or export paths.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: agent_a has no documented write or network surfaces, while agent_b explicitly cannot write_filesystem or modify_git_state. The pair lacks overlapping mutable-resource access, so capability conflict is provably blocked by the profiles.
conditions: IF agent_a is later granted write or network permissions, overlapping mutation could emerge.
mitigations: Do not grant agent_a filesystem or git permissions without a lock protocol.
Recheck permissions after any deployment change.

D_cascading_error.rationale: agent_b is a document-processing tool, so it may consume agent_a outputs as inputs if an operator wires them together. However, agent_b has no action-taking or write capabilities, and agent_a is a course repo rather than an autonomous fact source, so the blast radius is limited.
conditions: IF an orchestrator feeds agent_a text into agent_b without verification, downstream errors can propagate.
mitigations: Insert a human review step before agent_b uses agent_a output.
Require citations or source links in any transferred content.
Keep agent_b outputs advisory rather than authoritative.

E_compliance.rationale: No regulated data classes, residency constraints, or retention policies are documented for either agent, and both profiles show empty data_classes_touched. With no compliance-sensitive data flow identified, there is no documented mismatch to assess.
conditions: IF either agent is later assigned regulated data such as PHI or EU PII, compliance review is required.
mitigations: Add retention and residency notes to both profiles.
Block regulated data until a policy review is complete.
